text: #6572 decided (owner delegated 2026-09-30): APPEND FROM CSV/DELIMITED into a numeric field keeps REJECTING + rolling back a value still too wide after rounding, rather than copying VFP9's silent zero / silent decimal-dropping (both discard or alter imported data with no signal). Recorded in RQ-CF-PRG-CSV-NUMERIC-SCALE-001 and docs/81; regression test uses the issue's exact N(3,0) fixture (999,1000,-999,-1000,0,1.9 -> no rows appended). No opt-in compatibility switch added.
